entries.headline: Public flu uptake nears 3.8 million doses in under a month; stock reported below half
entries.why: Public programme (公費): the pace confirms strong demand and puts supply for the November 2 second stage in focus. ETtoday also covered self-pay options, so stock questions may reach the self-pay (自費) market.
entries.headline_zh: 公費流感疫苗接種不到一個月近380萬劑；傳庫存已不到一半
entries.why_zh: 公費：接種速度顯示需求強勁，11月2日第二階段的供應成為焦點。ETtoday也報導自費選項，庫存疑問可能延伸至自費市場。

entries.headline: COVID-19 shots pass one million under joint campaign; Novavax named in coverage
entries.why: Public programme (公費): outlets report flu up about 10% to 3.75 million in three weeks and COVID-19 above one million. Moderna and Novavax are both named, but no brand-level uptake figures were reported.
entries.headline_zh: 「左流右新」聯合接種下COVID-19疫苗突破百萬劑；報導提及Novavax
entries.why_zh: 公費：媒體報導流感疫苗三週內增加約10%至375萬劑，COVID-19疫苗逾百萬劑。報導同時提及Moderna與Novavax，但未公布各廠牌接種數據。

entries.headline: Local leaders push uptake: Taipei enhanced-flu promotion, Nantou COVID-19 drive, Tainan holiday sites
entries.why: Public programme (公費): Taipei's mayor directed stronger promotion of enhanced flu vaccines, and Nantou's magistrate urged free COVID-19 shots for people 50+ with health coins. Tainan passed 310,000 flu shots and added holiday sites, so local governments are now key channels.
entries.headline_zh: 地方首長推動接種：台北加強推廣加強型流感疫苗、南投推動COVID-19疫苗接種、台南增設假日站點
entries.why_zh: 公費：台北市長指示加強推廣加強型流感疫苗，南投縣長呼籲50歲以上民眾接種免費COVID-19疫苗並領取健康幣。台南流感疫苗接種突破31萬劑並增設假日站點，地方政府已成為關鍵管道。

entries.headline: Media amplify CDC extension of public flu antivirals to November 15
entries.why: Public programme (公費): coverage of the extension for seven high-transmission groups signals the agency still sees an active epidemic period. That keeps prevention messaging relevant through mid-November.
entries.headline_zh: 媒體擴散疾管署延長公費流感抗病毒藥劑至11月15日
entries.why_zh: 公費：針對七類高傳播族群延長措施的報導，顯示疾管署仍認為處於流行期，使預防訊息到11月中旬前仍具關聯性。

entries.headline: Matsu reports nearly 100 flu cases in Nangan within half a month
entries.why: A local outbreak report that mentions self-paid vaccination is one of the few self-pay (自費) references this week. It adds to the severity storyline outside Taiwan's main island.
entries.headline_zh: 馬祖南竿半個月內近百例流感病例
entries.why_zh: 這則提及自費接種的地方疫情報導，是本週少數涉及自費的內容，也為台灣本島以外的疫情嚴重性敘事增添素材。

entries.headline: Threads post blames COVID-19 vaccine for relative's ICU stay; flu supply rumours addressed
entries.why: A thin, low-engagement post presents an unverified link between the vaccine and a relative's illness. Together with an article responding to claims that quadrivalent flu vaccines have 'disappeared', it shows safety and supply doubts persisting at a low level; no funding arena is stated.
entries.headline_zh: Threads貼文將親人住進加護病房歸咎於COVID-19疫苗；流感疫苗供應謠言獲澄清
entries.why_zh: 一則內容單薄、互動度低的貼文提出疫苗與親人患病之間未經證實的關聯。加上一篇回應四價流感疫苗「消失」說法的文章，顯示安全性與供應疑慮仍低度持續；未說明屬公費或自費。

watch.text: Second stage of publicly funded flu vaccination opens. Watch whether reports of stock below half turn into access complaints.
watch.text_zh: 公費流感疫苗第二階段開打。觀察庫存不到一半的報導是否演變為接種困難的抱怨。

watch.text: Expanded eligibility for publicly funded flu antivirals expires. Watch for a further extension as a signal of season severity.
watch.text_zh: 公費流感抗病毒藥劑擴大適用對象措施到期。若再延長，可視為流行季嚴重程度的訊號。

watch.text: Delivery of the additional flu and Novavax doses Taiwan CDC said on October 13 it plans to procure.
watch.text_zh: 疾管署10月13日表示計畫採購的追加流感疫苗與Novavax疫苗到貨。

qa.q: Is there a flu vaccine shortage?
qa.a: There is no official shortage notice. Media and Facebook posts report stock below half after about 3.76-3.8 million doses. On October 13 Taiwan CDC said it plans additional flu doses, so supply questions are likely to grow before the November 2 second stage.
qa.a_zh: 目前無官方短缺公告。媒體與Facebook貼文指出，接種約376萬至380萬劑後庫存已不到一半。疾管署10月13日表示計畫追加流感疫苗，供應疑問可能在11月2日第二階段前增加。

qa.q: What is the latest on Novavax in the public COVID-19 programme?
qa.a: Taiwan CDC added Novavax as a public COVID-19 option from October 19 and said it plans more Novavax doses. Its October 20 notice listed Novavax as an option, and media name it alongside total COVID-19 uptake above one million, but no Novavax-specific uptake figure has been published.
qa.q_zh: Novavax在公費COVID-19疫苗接種計畫中的最新情況？
qa.a_zh: 疾管署自10月19日起將Novavax納入公費COVID-19疫苗選項，並表示計畫追加Novavax疫苗。10月20日公告將Novavax列為選項，媒體也在報導COVID-19疫苗總接種逾百萬劑時提及，但尚未公布Novavax個別接種數據。

qa.q: Is any misinformation active that needs attention?
qa.a: The main item is a viral claim of a Pentagon ban on Moderna's mRNA flu vaccine, which Taiwan CDC called false on October 20; it ran across several storylines this week. A single Threads post blaming the COVID-19 vaccine for a relative's ICU stay drew minimal engagement.
qa.q_zh: 目前是否有需要關注的錯誤訊息？
qa.a_zh: 主要是一則瘋傳的五角大廈禁用Moderna mRNA流感疫苗說法，疾管署已於10月20日澄清為錯誤訊息；本週橫跨多個議題。另有一則Threads貼文將親人住進加護病房歸咎於COVID-19疫苗，互動極少。

policy_notes.why: This pre-launch notice set the phase-one eligibility for 11 groups and the 1,350 health-coin incentive, and it referenced self-pay options, defining the boundary between the public and self-pay arenas.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此開打前公告訂定第一階段11類接種對象及1,350健康幣獎勵，並提及自費選項，劃定公費與自費的界線。

policy_notes.why: Formal launch of the joint 左流右新 campaign confirms enhanced flu vaccines are prioritised for long-term care residents 65+ and that both Moderna and Novavax are part of COVID-19 supply.
policy_notes.why_zh: 「左流右新」聯合接種活動正式啟動，確認加強型流感疫苗優先提供65歲以上長照機構住民，且Moderna與Novavax均為COVID-19疫苗供應來源。

policy_notes.why: This notice set the 2026-27 narrative that public flu and COVID-19 uptake is outpacing last year and urged high-risk groups to vaccinate before holiday travel.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此公告定調2026-27年度敘事：公費流感與COVID-19疫苗接種進度超越去年，並呼籲高風險族群於連假出遊前接種。

policy_notes.why: This notice confirmed strong public uptake, added Novavax to the public COVID-19 programme from October 19 and flagged extra flu and Novavax doses, a key supply and tender signal.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此公告確認公費接種踴躍，自10月19日起將Novavax納入公費COVID-19疫苗接種計畫，並提及追加流感與Novavax疫苗，是重要的供應與採購訊號。

policy_notes.why: This pre-holiday call reinforces health-coin incentives and lists Novavax as an option, sustaining official momentum behind the joint 左流右新 campaign.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此連假前呼籲強化健康幣誘因，並列出Novavax為選項，延續官方對「左流右新」聯合接種的推動力道。

policy_notes.why: This public notice extends antiviral eligibility to November 15, notes antivirals are outside National Health Insurance coverage, and frames flu as still in its epidemic period.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此公告將抗病毒藥劑適用延長至11月15日，指出抗病毒藥劑不在健保給付範圍，並定調流感仍處流行期。

policy_notes.why: This letter to physicians extends public flu antiviral use for high-transmission groups to November 15, showing the agency treats the season as still active.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此致醫師函將高傳播族群公費流感抗病毒藥劑使用延長至11月15日，顯示疾管署認為流行季仍持續。

policy_notes.why: Taiwan CDC's direct rebuttal of the Pentagon Moderna mRNA flu vaccine rumour shows the agency is actively policing vaccine misinformation this season.
policy_notes.why_zh: 疾管署直接駁斥五角大廈禁用Moderna mRNA流感疫苗謠言，顯示本季積極處理疫苗錯誤訊息。

misinfo.claim: The Pentagon has banned procurement and use of Moderna's mRNA flu vaccine across the US military
misinfo.note: Taiwan CDC has already called the claim false. Track reshares and, if asked, point stakeholders to the CDC clarification rather than amplifying the claim.
misinfo.claim_zh: 五角大廈已禁止美軍採購及使用Moderna mRNA流感疫苗
misinfo.note_zh: 疾管署已澄清此說法錯誤。追蹤轉傳情形，如遇詢問，引導利害關係人參考疾管署澄清，避免擴散該說法。

misinfo.claim: COVID-19 vaccine caused a previously active older relative's severe pneumonia and ICU stay
misinfo.note: This is a single low-engagement personal post. Monitor for repetition, and keep official safety-monitoring references ready for media enquiries.
misinfo.claim_zh: COVID-19疫苗導致原本活躍的長輩親人罹患重症肺炎並住進加護病房
misinfo.note_zh: 此為單一低互動的個人貼文。監測是否重複出現，並備妥官方安全性監測資料以回應媒體詢問。

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: Little this week. There were no items on nirsevimab or infant RSV antibodies. RSV mentions fell from 29 to 17 and came from an overseas roundup of US and Indian seasonal-virus approaches, plus adult-focused lectures.
products.implication: The infant-antibody conversation is quiet, so there is room to prepare evidence rather than react. The earlier parent discussion about paying for infant antibody has faded.
products.action: Keep an evidence pack and stakeholder map ready for any future public-funding or eligibility discussion. Monitor parenting forums for renewed questions about self-pay cost.
products.signal_zh: 本週動態甚少。無nirsevimab或嬰兒RSV抗體相關內容。RSV提及數從29降至17，來自海外對美國與印度季節性病毒對策的綜整，以及以成人為主的講座。
products.implication_zh: 嬰兒抗體討論沉寂，有空間預先準備實證而非被動回應。先前家長關於自費嬰兒抗體的討論已退燒。
products.action_zh: 備妥實證資料包與利害關係人地圖，以因應未來公費或適用對象討論。監測育兒論壇是否再出現自費費用疑問。

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.sub: Efluelda (菲優達), public programme for 65+ in long-term care
products.signal: High-dose vaccines are mentioned in CNA and other reports of the near 3.8 million public flu doses. ETtoday reports overall flu stock below half and mentions adjuvanted and high-dose options. Taipei's mayor directed stronger promotion of enhanced flu vaccines.
products.implication: With stock falling and second-stage eligibility opening on November 2, the first public season of enhanced vaccines may face questions on allocation, remaining doses and who outside long-term care can access them.
products.action: Prepare a factual supply and allocation briefing for Taiwan CDC and local health bureaus. Engage long-term care operators and geriatric clinicians on rollout experience. Have reactive lines ready on stock status, without making product claims.
products.sub_zh: Efluelda（菲優達），長照機構65歲以上公費
products.signal_zh: 中央社等報導公費流感疫苗近380萬劑時提及高劑量疫苗。ETtoday報導流感疫苗整體庫存不到一半，並提及佐劑型與高劑量選項。台北市長指示加強推廣加強型流感疫苗。
products.implication_zh: 隨庫存下降及11月2日第二階段開放，加強型疫苗的首個公費季可能面臨分配、剩餘劑量及長照以外對象能否接種等疑問。
products.action_zh: 為疾管署與地方衛生局準備客觀的供應與分配簡報。與長照業者及老年醫學臨床醫師交流推動經驗。備妥庫存狀況的回應說法，不做產品宣稱。
who_zh: 老年醫學與家庭醫學醫學會

products.name: Tdap booster
products.signal: Little this week. Tdap mentions fell from 6 to 3 and no item focused on Tdap or pertussis. The only related storyline is an earlier medical-society call on vaccines for chronic lung disease patients.
products.implication: There is no live public issue. Tdap is crowded out by the flu and COVID-19 campaign.
products.action: Maintain baseline monitoring. Keep relationships with obstetric and respiratory societies warm for later in the season, when the joint campaign news cycle eases.
products.signal_zh: 本週動態甚少。Tdap提及數從6降至3，無聚焦Tdap或百日咳的內容。唯一相關議題是先前醫學會呼籲慢性肺病患者接種疫苗。
products.implication_zh: 目前無進行中的公共議題。Tdap被流感與COVID-19疫苗宣導排擠。
products.action_zh: 維持基本監測。與婦產科及胸腔醫學會保持聯繫，待聯合接種新聞熱度在流行季後段趨緩時再推進。

products.name: Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine
products.signal: Taiwan CDC added Novavax as a public COVID-19 option from October 19 and said it plans additional Novavax doses. Its pre-holiday call again lists Novavax as an option. News coverage mentions Novavax mainly in passing, and there are no Novavax-specific uptake figures.
products.implication: In its first weeks of availability, the practical questions are where Novavax is offered and whether stock reaches sites. Standalone attention is fading as overall COVID-19 volume falls from 287 to 182.
products.action: Work with Taiwan CDC and local health bureaus so site-level availability information is accurate. Prepare a factual platform Q&A for healthcare professionals, not the public. Monitor COVID-19 safety posts that name no brand for any spillover.
products.sub_zh: 蛋白質次單位疫苗，10月19日起公費
products.signal_zh: 疾管署自10月19日起將Novavax納入公費COVID-19疫苗選項，並表示計畫追加Novavax疫苗。連假前呼籲再次列出Novavax為選項。新聞多僅順帶提及Novavax，且無Novavax個別接種數據。
products.implication_zh: 上市初期的實際問題在於哪裡提供Novavax、庫存是否送達各站點。隨COVID-19整體聲量從287降至182，單獨關注度逐漸下降。
products.action_zh: 與疾管署及地方衛生局合作，確保各站點供應資訊正確。為醫療專業人員（非一般民眾）準備客觀的技術平台Q&A。監測未提及廠牌的COVID-19安全性貼文是否外溢。

issues.title: Second-stage eligibility opens as flu stock is reported below half
issues.note: Wider public eligibility on top of dwindling stock could bring shortage stories and questions about enhanced-dose allocation. Prepare supply facts with Taiwan CDC.
issues.title_zh: 第二階段開放之際，流感疫苗庫存傳已不到一半
issues.note_zh: 在庫存減少之際擴大公費對象，可能引發短缺報導及加強型疫苗分配疑問。與疾管署共同準備供應資訊。

issues.title: Public flu antiviral extension expires while the season stays active
issues.note: Taiwan CDC tied the extension to the ongoing epidemic period, and the Matsu cluster suggests continued activity. Watch for a further extension or a shift in messaging.
issues.title_zh: 公費流感抗病毒藥劑延長措施到期，但疫情仍活躍
issues.note_zh: 疾管署將延長措施與持續流行期連結，馬祖群聚顯示疫情仍活躍。觀察是否再延長或訊息調整。

issues.title: Vaccine rumours recur after the debunked US military mRNA flu claim
issues.note: The rumour spread fast before Taiwan CDC rebutted it, and COVID-19 safety posts continue. Keep factual lines and HCP-facing materials ready, and defer to official rebuttals.
issues.title_zh: 美軍mRNA流感疫苗說法遭闢謠後，疫苗謠言可能再起
issues.note_zh: 該謠言在疾管署駁斥前迅速擴散，COVID-19安全性貼文也持續出現。備妥客觀說法與醫療專業人員資料，並以官方澄清為準。

self_pay.title: Self-pay mentioned alongside shrinking public stock
self_pay.note: Reports of public flu stock below half also reference self-paid options, but give no prices, brands or clinic stock levels.
self_pay.title_zh: 公費庫存減少之際，報導提及自費
self_pay.note_zh: 公費流感疫苗庫存不到一半的報導也提及自費選項，但未提供價格、廠牌或診所庫存。

self_pay.title: Outbreak areas may drive private demand
self_pay.note: Coverage of nearly 100 flu cases in Nangan, Matsu, mentions self-paid vaccination, a possible demand signal from people outside the eligible groups.
self_pay.title_zh: 疫情地區可能帶動自費需求
self_pay.note_zh: 馬祖南竿近百例流感的報導提及自費接種，可能是非公費對象需求的訊號。

self_pay.title: Silent on enhanced flu, RSV antibody and Tdap self-pay
self_pay.note: This week's items say nothing about self-pay availability, price or clinic promotion for adjuvanted or high-dose flu vaccines, infant RSV antibodies or Tdap.
self_pay.title_zh: 加強型流感疫苗、RSV抗體與Tdap自費無相關討論
self_pay.note_zh: 本週內容未提及佐劑型或高劑量流感疫苗、嬰兒RSV抗體或Tdap的自費供應、價格或診所推廣。
